log: You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
You take down the notice: Thin out the Conger Eels.
You make your way to Tarred Street.
You make your way to Cobbled Street.
A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
You make your way to Fish-Smelling Street.
A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
You make your way to Weathered Market.
You buy 4 Iron Ore at the Market for 12 gold.
You buy 4 Seasoned Timber at the Market for 12 gold.
You sell 1 Seasoned Timber to the Market for 1 gold.
A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
You return to The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 2 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
A cart rattles past and away down the road.
The smith makes you a Cutlass for 17 gold.
The smith works on it for 5 gold: it's now a Driftwood Club +1.
You buy the Storm Lantern from the Smithy for 6 gold.
You sell the Storm Lantern to the Smithy for 1 gold.
A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
You buy 1 Ship's Biscuit at the Market for 2 gold.
You make your way to Weathered Street.
You make your way to Shuttered Tavern.
The Tavern has beds for 4 gold a night and a kitchen.
You buy a Kelp Broth at the Tavern for 6 gold.
You buy a Mussel Stew at the Tavern for 8 gold.
You eat the Mussel Stew. It'll keep you going for 60 turns.
Somebody laughs too loudly at a corner table.
Somebody laughs too loudly at a corner table.
Somebody laughs too loudly at a corner table.

ambient: A bird starts to sing, then stops.
rooms.description: A clearing of soft grass, ringed by pines that all lean the same way.
rooms.name: Ferny Glade

ambient: Surf booms behind you.
Gulls wheel overhead and will not follow you in.
rooms.description: A ragged opening in the cliff, half-drowned at high tide. Cold air breathes out of it, smelling of salt and old stone.
rooms.name: The Cave Mouth

ambient: A drop of water lands on your neck.
The glow pulses, very slowly.
rooms.description: A low dome of wet rock. Water beads on every surface and falls in slow, ringing drops.
features: A ring of pebbles, carefully arranged, around nothing at all.
rooms.name: Dripping Grotto

ambient: Your footsteps come back to you a moment late.
rooms.description: A winding passage, scoured smooth by water. You walk bent to keep your head clear.
rooms.name: Bone-White Passage

ambient: Your footsteps come back to you a moment late.
rooms.description: A crack in the rock just wide enough to pass, its walls slick with weed.
rooms.name: Sunken Passage

ambient: The pool shivers, though nothing touched it.
rooms.description: The floor dips into a pool that rises and falls with a tide you cannot hear.
features: Pale anemones close as your shadow passes over them.
rooms.name: Flooded Tidal Pool

rooms.name: Brackish Tidal Pool

rooms.description: A small, dry chamber with a flat stone like an altar at its centre.
features: A rune scratched into the stone, worn almost smooth.
Offerings of sea-glass, sorted by colour.
rooms.name: Flooded Shrine

ambient: A bubble rises from the black water and breaks.
rooms.description: The floor slopes down to black water. The air is thick and still.
rooms.name: Sunken Sump

ambient: Somewhere, something gnaws.
rooms.description: Small bones crunch underfoot. Something feeds here, and is tidy about it.
features: A gull skull, polished, set apart from the rest.
rooms.name: Hollow Bone Shelf

ambient: Wind whistles across the mouth of the shaft.
Spoil heaps shift and settle.
rooms.description: A winding house of grey stone stands over the shaft, roofless, its wheel seized with rust.
rooms.name: The Mine Head

ambient: A timber groans.
Grit trickles from the ceiling.
rooms.description: A tunnel braced with old timbers, some of them bowed under the weight.
rooms.name: Timbered Tunnel

ambient: Your lamp-shadow stretches across the far wall.
rooms.description: A chamber hollowed out by years of digging, its roof held up by pillars of ore.
features: A pick, its handle long rotted, still wedged in the rock face.
rooms.name: Flooded Gallery

ambient: Your lamp-shadow stretches across the far wall.
rooms.description: A wide gallery where a seam was followed until it ran out.
features: A pick, its handle long rotted, still wedged in the rock face.
rooms.name: Cold Gallery

ambient: A timber groans.

rooms.description: A cramped drift cut through dark rock, chisel marks still sharp.

ambient: Water drips into the sump, steady as a clock.

rooms.name: Flooded Sump

ambient: A cart rattles past and away down the road.
Someone calls a greeting from a window, then thinks better of it.
rooms.description: A gate of grey driftwood, bound with iron and left open. Roads leave from here along the coast and inland.
features: A gatekeeper's stool, empty, with a half-mended net draped over it.
A signpost whose arms have been repainted so often the letters stand out in relief.
rooms.name: The Town Gate

ambient: A hammer rings, stops, rings again.
rooms.description: An open-fronted smithy hung with anchors, hooks and chain.
rooms.name: Shuttered Smithy

ambient: A shutter bangs somewhere above you.
Gulls squabble on a rooftop.
rooms.description: A street of fish-scale shingles and blue doors, every one of them shut.
features: A rain barrel with a dead crab floating in it.
rooms.name: Tarred Street

ambient: A boat creaks against its fenders.
The tide slaps at the steps.
rooms.description: A long quay of black stone, slick with weed below the high-water line.
rooms.name: Narrow Quay

ambient: A trader shouts a price, then a lower one.
Coins clink somewhere nearby.
rooms.description: A cobbled square where traders call prices into the wind.
features: A scale with brass weights stamped with three different harbour marks.
rooms.name: Cobbled Market
